requirements.text: Students must be able to personalise their timetable views by colour-coding modules, hiding cancelled classes, and adding study blocks.
The system must automatically alert students when a new grade is posted or when assignment deadlines are approaching.
Students must have the ability to choose how they receive notifications (email, SMS, in-app messages).
Students must be able to choose the frequency of notifications (immediate, daily, weekly summaries).
Students must be able to toggle notifications on and off for specific modules.
The feedback system must gather anonymous feedback on course content quality, delivery, resources, workload, and assessment fairness.
The feedback system must ensure that feedback is only accessible to module coordinators after grades are submitted.
All enhancements must integrate seamlessly into the existing portal without requiring additional login processes or new software installations.
No changes can be made to the current student records database schema.
All student data processed by these new features must comply with GDPR regulations and the university’s data retention policy.
